App Studio: bulk feature style selection (Vega-aligned) (#262)

* Add bulk feature style selection in App Studio features page.

Align Robin with Vega: one style key applies to all supporting features, with per-feature overrides under advanced settings.

* Fix uniform style detection and per-feature style load errors.

Require every feature with styles to have a selection before treating keys as uniform; show unavailable when a style query fails.
